surviving_residual_claims: training-support crossover under matched architecture, initialization policy, corpus size, scene pool, tokenizer, optimizer, training horizon and one shared decoder

standalone_paper_stop_rule: If the future P1 support crossover has no meaningful residual, or a residual cannot be selectively localized/recovered by the exact-identity oracle intervention, stop the standalone mechanism paper rather than redefining topology or switching endpoints after outcomes.
